1.content: - 0bb16dbb-1e4a-434b-816b-829e0695b59b: S denotes the starting cell; G denotes the goal cell that grants a reward of 1 upon entry; H denotes a hazardous cell that terminates the episode with zero reward upon entry (lethal); F denotes a free, traversable cell.

2.content: The agent can move one cell per step in the four cardinal directions (up, down, left, right) provided the target cell is within the grid bounds. Moving onto a hazardous (H) cell is allowed but terminates the episode with zero reward.

3.content: A reward of 1 is received only when the agent moves onto the goal cell (G), which also terminates the episode; all other moves yield a reward of 0.

5.content: Hazard cells (H) can be created dynamically: after the agent moves, the cell it vacated becomes a hazard. Thus hazard positions are not fixed for the entire episode.
